caption:
The call to the soul at peace

These verses tell of the tranquil soul being called back to its Lord, well pleased and pleasing to Him, and welcomed into His Paradise. Let this be the hope you carry into sleep tonight.

Surah Al-Fajr 89:27-30

Send this to someone whose heart needs rest tonight

#jannah #tranquilsoul #surahalfajr #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
